list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; all offline single-player

guide_sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

roadmap_note: Roadmap built from the official descriptions and the three-step routes published by PowerPyx and KeenGamer: story first (60-80 hours), then the 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours), then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (10-20 hours). About 200 hours in total, one playthrough, no online play, no mission replay — keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy you will earn, after the story, the 100% checklist and every side activity. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx roadmap.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — just play through the start of the game as Jason. Sources: official list on Exophase; Push Square guide.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one-time balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter closes. Sources: official list on Exophase; PowerPyx roadmap.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions; it unlocks when the chapter ends. From here on Jason and Lucia are playable together, which later meditation spots need. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3's main missions and it pops at the chapter close. Keep taking optional missions as their icons appear — they feed the 100% checklist later. Sources: official list on Exophase; Push Square guide.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4's main missions. This is the chapter where the big bank vault robberies open up (the mission That's Where The Money Is…), so do not skip the robbery introductions. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final story mission and the credits roll with this trophy. After the story you return to free roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats. Sources: official list on Exophase; Push Square guide.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set story beat, so just follow the mission markers when it unlocks. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission Child's Play when the story brings it up. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission Headliners. Like every named story mission trophy, it pops on completion and cannot be missed. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind — gold. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. You do not need literally everything: most rows ask for a portion (for example 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts), but a few rows demand the full set — every gang operation (39), bank job (22), payday loan job (7), bank vault (8), underwater discovery (33), shooting-range gold (42), drone time trial (42) and Bret target deck (15). Progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours, most of it here. Sources: PowerPyx roadmap and 100% checklist guide; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Stunts you do naturally while driving count, and the 100% checklist wants 300 of them, so keep going past 250. Track your total in the Progress menu. Sources: PowerPyx roadmap; GameMapa trophy list.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, bowling, basketball, mini-golf and the arcade games. One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. Tick them off early in free roam so you know which are left. Sources: KeenGamer trophy table; GameMapa trophy list.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every shooting range in Leonida and play each challenge until gold — the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional for the platinum. Use a steady weapon you are comfortable with and replay a challenge as many times as it takes. Sources: official list on Exophase; PowerPyx roadmap.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; winning once per location is enough for the trophy, while the 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials finished. Learn the racing line on a slow first pass, then go for the win. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race twice does not count twice. Leonida has 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, so aim past 20 while you are at it. Pick a fast car you trust and use the race markers on the map. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced through the story's Gone Fishing mission; afterwards you can take on fishing challenges, and Cal is the rival to beat. Pick a good spot, watch the line tension and reel steadily. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any machine counts and one completed game is enough. The 100% checklist asks you to play all four video games, so try the rest while you are there. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger and side strands appear as their icons on the map as the story opens them up — follow Andy's chain to its end. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Kenton also ties into the treasure sets the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 of, so collect treasure maps as you go. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so check the map for Billy's icon between chapters. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete eight full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the game, so you can skip one you dislike — but a strand only counts when its final mission is done, not when it starts. The five character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are strands of their own and count toward the eight. Sources: official list on Exophase; PowerPyx roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this first. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The catch is in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, follows her to the balcony and accept. That balcony meditation raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it cannot be done again after Chapter 1 — it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The other spots open up as you explore; the last ones need Jason and Lucia playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2. Note: the 100% checklist only wants 15 of 18 meditations, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road. Sources: PowerPyx roadmap (missable warning); KeenGamer roadmap step 1; Vice City Hustle trophy list.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strands (his Target Decks) ask you to track down specific animals; finish one of his unique-animal hunts. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's target decks done, so you will be hunting for him anyway. Study animals through binoculars first — studying 100 species is a separate checklist row. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete three full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so you will be collecting cards for a long while — three sets is just the early milestone. Cards are scattered across Leonida; use the map and your collection screen to see which sets are nearly done. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Open the WAiNK app on your in-game phone and scan 100 different locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scan everything unfamiliar as you travel, because the 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans and vehicles can be scanned too (200 base-model vehicles). Sources: official list on Exophase; PowerPyx roadmap step 1.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are small objectives spread across combat, driving, exploration and activities — check the Challenges list in the Progress menu and pick off the easy ones first. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so you can skip the ten hardest. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with good cover and a fast car waiting — break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, then drive clear. Easiest once both characters are playable together. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the heat on the whole time. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without hiding or getting busted. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a quick WAiNK scan of a new vehicle is enough to count it. Scan every unfamiliar car, bike and boat you pass from the start of the game; the 100% checklist separately wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this habit pays twice. Sources: official list on Exophase; GameMapa trophy list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it runs out. A gang shootout or a police chase with several officers nearby is the natural place for it. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off in it — an unscheduled departure, in the trophy's words. Head to the runways, board a plane that is about to leave and get airborne before security stops you. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks show up when your wanted level is high and the military responds — or at military sites. Grab one, then put its cannon to work. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. The big vault jobs open up during Chapter 4 through the mission That's Where The Money Is… — the 100% checklist wants all eight vaults robbed, so keep going to eight. Plan your getaway car before you go in. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops. A sticky approach on a quiet road works better than a shootout in traffic. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the map. Drive, fly and sail through every named area until the map is fully uncovered. The easiest way is a long road trip after the story, checking the map for dark patches you have never visited. Sources: official list on Exophase; PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered; hit one per gang — nine in total. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations done, so this is the first step of a much longer robbery list. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites, so linger at the beachfront until it pops. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table (exact trigger unconfirmed).
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. The exact method is still being confirmed by the guide sites; a fast car and a straight run at the storefront is the reported approach. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table (exact method unconfirmed).
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the reported method is to steal the three key valuables kept at the alley and escape. Visit the bowling alley, take the valuables and get out clean. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the reported method is to raise the Strength stat to its maximum for both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters (gym work and physical activity build Strength) until each hits the cap. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — PSN tracks a count up to 500. Almost anything with consequences counts: crimes, choices in missions, robberies, stunts that draw attention. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough; check your profile progress in the Progress menu and keep playing the way the game rewards. Sources: official list on Exophase; GameMapa trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy, and its unlock method is still unconfirmed — the guide sites list it as unsolved. Its description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. Try failing an activity or challenge once and then passing it on the retry. We will update this guide when a source confirms the method. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table (method unconfirmed).
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy, method still unconfirmed — the guide sites list it as unsolved, and its description ('What the hell just happened?') points at witnessing something strange or paranormal in Leonida. Explore odd spots at night and keep an eye out for unusual events. We will update this guide when a source confirms the method. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table (method unconfirmed).
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed; the reported approach is a drive-by swing at a pedestrian from a slow-moving car or bike. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table (precise method unconfirmed).
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through your contacts a little at a time and the total builds up. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this overlaps fully with A Long Road. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer 100% section.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything you buy counts. It adds up naturally over a 200-hour playthrough, especially once you start buying garage properties and kitting out cars. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties across Leonida. Garages appear for sale as you explore and earn money — the robberies and fencing from the 100% checklist will fund them. Buy each one when its for-sale sign shows. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Drive a vehicle you own into the app's registration flow and repeat for ten different vehicles. Any vehicles you already own count once registered. Sources: official list on Exophase; KeenGamer trophy table.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
